Fight With Your Mind is an activism and advocacy organization with a mission to fight information warfare by teaching how it is used and why it is effective.

Our goal is to bring truth and a shared reality back into focus by challenging the public to question and analyze information, and better understand our differences through expertise, education, and empathy.

To prioritize the truth – the self, the opinion, and the fear of the unknown must take a humble back seat.

In this safe environment we challenge you to explore your own perceptions, question your opinions, and see the world through a lens different from your own.

We are a country and a world divided more than ever before. Our collective situation has been compared to many embattled periods of conflict in history but…

Never before in this country have we experienced a total loss of agreement on how to perceive reality or information itself.

This is not surprising because all new war tactics are unfamiliar to the first generation of victims they are used on. As a whole, we are untrained on the rules of information warfare, which is a war fought in the background, by obfuscated entities, on a public that is unaware of its participation.

This is the world we live in today, and the only way to fight information warfare is to know better, to understand the rules of war by studying the tactics, to ask questions, and to always remember that the truth will stand up to scrutiny. The abilities to think, to be mindful, to be analytical, and to be observant are now valuable defenses in this war.

Hey trendsetter, we need your help!

We are a 100% volunteer organization. Contributors share expertise free of charge because they believe in our mission to fight information warfare by teaching how it is used and why it is effective. Together we can bring a shared reality back into focus by challenging ourselves to explore our own perceptions, question our opinions, and better understand our differences through expertise, education, and empathy.

We can't do what we do without you!

While most of the heavy lifting is done free of charge, Fight With Your Mind has bills to pay. Even small contributions help us cover costs such as hosting, licensing, and other fees associated with keeping the site online.

Featured Cause

Fight With Your Mind is a proud advocate for "lost causes" and works hard to bring overlooked issues into the light. We donate 100% of the funds we collect here to help those that have fallen through the many cracks of our society, and support worthy causes that have been overlooked, even by other charities.

Fight With Your Mind is brought to you by Bootstrap Commercial Arts

Fighting injustice with wide reaching visual, virtual, and verbal communication.

After spending time working in a marketing industry that capitalizes on the science and psychology of public manipulation, the former corporate marketers and founders of Bootstrap parted ways with big business.

Bootstrap Commercial Arts, founder of the movement Fight With Your Mind, was created to better align a set of skills from the marketing industry with the concept that marketing can be and should be about honesty and communication, and that people, not unaccountable entities, should be running our economy.

Businesses should have products or services of value that are presented to demographics that possess an actual need, desire, or demand for what a business supplies. Marketers should facilitate that honest communication between the business and the public.

Like any powerful tool, marketing can be misused, and people can be hurt and taken advantage of. Unfortunately, marketing has become synonymous with brainwashing at times, and the term information warfare has become a threat that everyone should understand in order to protect themselves.

Fight With Your Mind is one of 4 arms of Bootstrap Commercial Arts, all intended to fight injustice with commercial art. Learn more about Bootstrap and it's other arms of change:

Fighting dishonest marketing practices and information warfare by providing honesty to the public and honesty to the client.

Fighting the injustice and inequality homeless endure by providing a four step program, a community and support group, resource center, training hub, and employment entry program that requires no government assistance, capital, or public monetary donation to operate.

Fighting the culture that drives information warfare through social media alternatives. Taking control of the future and not accepting a dire fate.
